lines.text: Last but not least, track sixteen, "One Last Thing"
That's the outro, you know, that's me kinda just comin' back after the end
And just kinda leavin' it all out there on the table
Um, that's like my favorite bars I've ever rhymed in my life
Um, and that's really how I wanted to end the album
I wanted to go out rhymin', 'cause that's how I came in
That's how I started and I wanted to go out rappin' my ass off
Can I say "ass" on the radio?
